channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Firm partners with TV presenter and podcaster on 'unbelievable' project
item.description: Minors & Brady has partnered with Jake Humphrey's High Performance Foundation in a bid to help inspire and support young people.

item.title: Winners of region's annual energy awards announced
item.description: The winners of the East of England Energy Group's (EEEGR) annual awards have been announced.

item.title: Teen dies of drug use after starting cocaine habit following relationship break-up
item.description: A Norfolk teenager died of cocaine use five months after he started taking the drug following the breakdown of a relationship.

item.title: NHS bosses threaten to object to 500-home development as services 'at capacity'
item.description: Norfolk's integrated care partnership has intervened over plans to build 500 homes on land off Links Road in Gorleston, warning services are over-stretched.

item.title: Furious folk want farm shop closed over claims of late night music and traffic chaos
item.description: Broadland District Council has issued a farm shop and cafe in Salhouse with an enforcement notice. Angry locals are calling for the business to be closed down.

item.title: Owners of city's new drinking spot hoping to attract Canaries fans
item.description: Toby Westgarth and Dom Burke are hoping to attract City fans and Christmas shoppers at their new site in the city’s new shopping village.

item.title: Bid to demolish building to make way for a home gets approved
item.description: An application to build a three-bedroom home on Orwell Road near Norwich's centre have been approved by the council.

item.title: Revised bin collection dates across district over festive season
item.description: Bin collection days for householders across East Suffolk are set to change over the festive period.

item.title: 100-year-old becomes major hit on Japanese national television
item.description: A 100-year-old woman from Great Yarmouth has inspired viewers on Japanese national television channel TBS with her table tennis prowess.

item.title: There was an unexpected lesson in this hymn
item.description: A fortnight ago, I returned from a much-needed time in the sunshine, a spiritual retreat as well as a holiday.
